thread.title: Trump tells Apple to make products in US

title: Trump tells Apple to make products in US
text:
Listen Trump tells Apple to make products in US
WASHINGTON: US President Trump tweeted on Saturday that Apple Inc (AAPL.O) should make products inside the United States if it wants to avoid tariffs on Chinese imports.
The company told trade officials in a letter on Friday that the proposed tariffs would affect prices for a “wide range” of Apple products, including its Watch, but it did not mention the iPhone.
